type Point = { readonly x: number; y: number };
class Counter {
  get count(): number {
    return 1;
  }
  step = 2;
}

function setPoint(point: Point, key: "x" | "y"): void {
  point[key] = 1;
}

function setAny(point: Point, key: keyof Point): void {
  point[key] = 1;
}

function setCounter(counter: Counter, key: "count" | "step"): void {
  counter[key] = 3;
}

function setEither(point: Point | { x: number; y: number }, key: "x" | "y"): void {
  point[key] = 1;
}

function setY(point: Point, key: "y"): void {
  point[key] = 1;
}

const point: Point = { x: 1, y: 2 };
setY(point, "y");
setPoint(point, "x");
setAny(point, "y");
setCounter(new Counter(), "step");
setEither(point, "y");
console.log(point.y);
